description: MainActivity.java for an Android app, serving as the launcher activity that manages UI fragments, menu options, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android launcher activity that manages fragment display, menu options, and logging initialization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and adds ClippingBasicFragment if no saved state.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu, toggling log visibility and title based on mLogShown.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with LogWrapper, MessageOnlyLogFilter, and LogFragment.
